# Homesthetics

> > Homesthetics is a DIY and home decor inspiration hub offering hundreds of budget-friendly design ideas, craft projects, and interior improvement guides for every room and style.

Homesthetics provides extensive collections of DIY projects, home decor inspiration, and craft tutorials across bedroom design, furniture, outdoor spaces, and upcycling. The site is known for curating large galleries of design ideas (often 30-80+ per article) to inspire homeowners and DIY enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- DIY Projects
- Home Decor
- Interior Design
- Bedroom Design
- Budget-Friendly Ideas
- Craft Tutorials
- Upcycling
- Furniture Design
- Garden Ideas
- Home Improvement
- Design Inspiration
- Easy Projects
- Outdoor Spaces
- Craft Ideas
